interpretation.null_result_limit: A null cannot distinguish Pluto-internal/direct-field leakage from state-independent RX2-cable or selector-common-launch leakage.
interpretation.positive_result_scope: A positive differential can identify only a selector/control-state-dependent or fixture-interaction contribution; it does not by itself locate that term.
interpretation.proven: No central ALL_OFF stratum in the fixed twenty-repeat corpus satisfies both the chosen 0.5%-of-H_off amplitude resolution gate and 0.75 cross-capture phase-coherence gate.
interpretation.required_next_discriminant: Stage A direct-RX2 termination followed by Stage B cable and Stage C powered selector-common boundary captures

method.cross_capture_center: component-wise median across exactly twenty captures
method.decision_contract: chosen resolution threshold and phase-coherence threshold must both pass; this is a bounded detection contract, not proof that smaller effects are absent
method.differential_strata: seven ordinary guards after ANT1-ANT7 plus the first marker interval after ANT8; marker_entry_after_ANT8 is not labeled a protocol post-ANT8 guard
method.marker_baseline: component-wise median in marker window; complex linear interpolation between bracketing marker anchors
method.negative_control: central 2-3 ms of the contiguous pre-ANT1 ALL_OFF guard; its nominal start has no RF state transition
method.normalization: each capture residual divided by its marker-only complex H_off

source.cohort_selection: repeat-1 through repeat-20 source_runs from the committed 20-pass result; the separate baseline run is excluded; exact 5.8 GHz only
